relationships.subject: memantine
relationships.evidence_quote: Memantine alleviated pain indicators in diabetic mice and suppressed excessive NMDAR1 activation, glutamate, and pro-inflammatory cytokine release in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Once located extracellularly, HMGB1 amplifies proinflammatory and pronociceptive signals through its action on the innate immune receptors comprising toll-like receptors (TLR2 and TLR4)

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 mediates HMGB1 pro-inflammatory effects through the activation of NF-kB.

key_findings: Spinal HMGB1, TLR4, p-NF-kB, NMDAR1, TNF-alpha, IL-1β and glutamate are elevated in alloxan diabetic mice with neuropathic pain.
Memantine lowered these spinal markers and improved allodynia, hyperalgesia and histopathology.
